title: Ki Sur Jingrwai U Hynniew Trep (Melodies of the Seven Huts)
khasi_title: Ki Sur Jingrwai U Hynniew Trep
cultural_context: Chanted in communal gathering celebrating the primordial covenant between God and the Sixteen Huts upon Lum Sohpetbneng.

khasi: Na kliar u Lum Sohpetbneng ba thiang,
U kynjri ksier u hiar na bneng sha khyndew,
Ki Hynniew Trep ki wan shong neh ha ri,
Ban pynriewspah ia ka sneng ka akor.
english: From the sweet crown of Lum Sohpetbneng,
The golden celestial ladder descended to earth,
The Seven Huts came to dwell in this land,
To enrich the divine wisdom and moral conduct.

khasi: U Blei Nongbuh u kyrkhu ia ka hima,
Ynda ngi bat ia ka hok bad ka jingshisha,
Kamai ia ka hok ha madan bad ha them,
Pynsah ia ka nam ba phyrnai haduh bynrei.
english: God the Arranger blesses the sovereign realm,
When we hold fast to righteousness and truth,
Earn righteousness upon the highlands and valleys,
Leaving a shining name for generations yet to come.

vocabulary.kynjri-ksier: golden celestial umbilical cord / ladder of communion
vocabulary.hynniew-trep: the Seven Huts / Khasi ancestral race
